outputs: This model is a compact vision-language model designed for edge devices, featuring under 1 billion parameters. It excels in generating Korean image captions, making it ideal for applications in mobile and IoT environments. The model supports Korean as its primary language and is optimized for low-latency inference, ensuring quick responses even on limited hardware. Its strengths lie in its efficient architecture and ability to understand visual content in conjunction with Korean text, making it suitable for tasks such as automated image tagging, content creation, and accessibility features. The model is available in GGUF format and is licensed for commercial use.
